target_text: // KV_MUL is the number of query heads that share the K/V head.
body:
**[comments] Rule 2, restates identifiers: shorten**

The first sentence restates the name check_reader_against_dotter<KV_MUL>. The qk_group sentence restates the callee's comment on MAX_KV_MUL_16 (Rule 5), and the 20-head and 32-head sentences restate the SECTION names on lines 337 and 340. Only the meaning of KV_MUL is a fact the names do not carry.

Proposed:
```cpp
// KV_MUL is the number of query heads that share the K/V head.
```
